question: The average bankruptcy rate and M&A deals by year
query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', date) AS year, AVG(bankruptcy_rate) AS avg_bankruptcy_rate, AVG(mergers_acquisitions_deals) AS avg_mergers_acquisitions_deals FROM finance_economics_dataset GROUP BY year LIMIT 50
answer:
From the data provided, we can see that the average bankruptcy rate and M&A deals have fluctuated over the years. In 2000, the average bankruptcy rate was approximately 5.07%, and there were about 23.64 M&A deals. By 2008, this had increased to an average bankruptcy rate of around 5.28% with approximately 21.87 M&A deals. The most significant increase in both averages occurred between 2000 and 2008.

In terms of M&A deals, the highest value was seen in 2004 with about 25.23 deals. This number decreased to around 21.87 in 2008, before increasing slightly to approximately 24.83 by 2007 and then to about 25.16 by 2003.

The average bankruptcy rate also showed a similar pattern of fluctuation over the years, starting at around 5.07% in 2000 and rising slightly to approximately 5.28% in 2008.
